description: The HyperFormula engine wired into the Svelte 5 data grid as an optional peer dependency. The grid holds raw values such as =SUM(B2:B10) so the inline editor edits the formula itself, while a cell renderer shows the computed value from a parallel HyperFormula snapshot. A syntax-highlighted formula bar, marching-ants outline on copied cells, per-row heights with rowResize and coloured merged section headers through spreadsheetLayout complete it, with formula families for math, lookup, text, date, logical, financial and statistical functions.

faq.question: How are raw and computed values kept apart?
faq.answer: The grid's data holds the raw text. A HyperFormula instance mirrors it; on every commit the demo updates the engine and refreshes a computed snapshot, and each cell's snippet displays the snapshot value while editing shows the raw formula.

faq.question: Is HyperFormula bundled with SvGrid?
faq.answer: No. It is an optional peer dependency the demo imports directly; the grid itself has no formula engine dependency. Add it to your project when you need its function library.

faq.question: How is the copy outline drawn?
faq.answer: Ctrl+C stores the copied range from api.getSelected(); cellClass adds a marching-ants class to cells in that range, and Escape or another copy clears it.
